	#Generic
	###company_private_construction
	if = {
		limit = {
			maximum_number_companies_exceeded_monthly_pulse >= 1 #les Compagnie classique ne +1 pas comme les bank
			NOT = {
				has_company = company_type:company_private_construction
			}
			# any_scope_building = { #inutile il possede deja un centre fiancier
			# 	is_building_type = building_construction_sector
			# 	level >= 1
			# }
		}
		add_company = company_type:company_private_construction
		random_scope_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					or = {
						any_scope_building = {
							is_building_type = building_construction_sector
							level < 10
						}
						not = {
							has_building = building_construction_sector
						}
					}
				}
				create_building={
					building="building_construction_sector"
					add_ownership={
						company={
							type=company_private_construction
							country="ROOT"
							levels=5
						}
					}
					reserves=1
				}
			}
		}
	}

			if = {
				limit = {
					or = {
						not = { has_building = building_railway }

							is_building_type = building_railway
							level < 10
						}
					}

			game_date > 1707
			c:AUS ?= this
			NOT = { has_company = company_type:company_Dorotheum }
			#maximum_number_companies_exceeded_monthly_pulse >= 1 #les Compagnie classique ne +1 pas comme les bank
		}
		add_company = company_type:company_Dorotheum
		random_scope_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					or = {
						not = { has_building = building_trade_center }
						any_scope_building = {
							is_building_type = building_trade_center
							level < 10
						}
					}
				}
				create_building = {
					building = "building_trade_center"
					add_ownership = {
						company = {
							type = company_Dorotheum
							country = "c:AUS"
							levels = 5
						}
					}
					reserves = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}

			#maximum_number_companies_exceeded_monthly_pulse >= 1 #les Compagnie classique ne +1 pas comme les bank
		}
		add_company = company_type:company_Vinci
		random_scope_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					or = {
						not = { has_building = building_steel_mill }
						any_scope_building = {
							is_building_type = building_steel_mill
							level < 10
						}
					}
				}
				create_building = {
					building = "building_steel_mill"
					add_ownership = {
						company = {
							type = company_Vinci
							country = "c:FRA"
							levels = 5
						}
					}
					reserves = 1
				}
			}
		}

				create_building = {

		random_scope_state = {

			has_technology_researched = pumpjacks

					add_ownership={

							country="ROOT"
							levels=10
						}
					}
					reserves=1
				}
			}
		}
	}


	#Prosperity
	random_company = {
		limit = {
			is_producing_prestige_goods = no
			or = {
				is_company_type = company_type:company_basic_silver_mining_mex
				is_company_type = company_type:company_private_construction
				is_company_type = company_type:company_PennsylvaniaRailroad
				is_company_type = company_type:company_standard_oil
			}
			executive = {
				not = {
					has_modifier = UNI_modifier_1
				}
			}
		}
		executive = {
			save_scope_as = company_for_UNI_modifier_1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:company_for_UNI_modifier_1
		}
		scope:company_for_UNI_modifier_1 = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = UNI_modifier_1
				months = 12
			}
		}
	}
}
